_notes: ROLLING now tracks the STABLE predecessor of the candidate, not the highest prerelease. For the 1.4.0 stable cut, both axes anchor on 1.3.0 (floor generous 10%, rolling tight 5%). After 1.4.0 ships, advance rolling to 1.4.0 for the next stable cut. The successor guard in gate.mjs additionally auto-skips any axis whose baseline is version-numerically NEWER than the candidate (a version cannot regress against its own future), so back-releasing a stable while prereleases exist no longer produces phantom failures. Tolerances calibrated against measured self-noise (npm run calibrate: frame.avg <=3.4%, frame.p99 up to 14%). NOTE: baselines must carry >=3 reps (minReps) -- a single-rep floor is not evidence; the evidence guard will exit 3 (RECAPTURE) rather than judge against it.
